hypothesis: The completed frozen-eval STG objective failure is consistent with a surrogate BatchNorm mode gap: the same frozen learned parameters can classify the fixed external target batches better using minibatch statistics than using frozen running statistics.
new_observable: Paired target-class200 counts and CE of a fixed surrogate under eval versus disposable train-BN copies, for saved zero/final-delta inputs. Previous gradient algebra checks and victim evaluation did not measure this factorial comparison.
comparison_scope: Implementation diagnosis only. BN gaps can occur in benign/non-IID models; this neither resolves D08/D15 nor validates a server detector or the final-FU causal explanation.
input_rule: Use exact saved augmented x, no new augmentation. zero=x; final_delta=clip(x+final_delta,-1,1).
BN_copy_rule: Each cell gets a fresh immutable-state copy. Learned parameters are frozen. train_BN_copy may update only running_mean/running_var/num_batches_tracked; discard immediately. Never substitute for or train into a source checkpoint.
additional_support_rule: target hits must strictly improve in both stored batches
positive_rule_scope: Consistent with a BN mode gap only; not proof of transfer/FU causality, automatic profile adoption, or performance reproduction.
independent_check: New process, CPU1, saved FP32 logits only. Python argmax and stable fsum/logsumexp CE. Exact counts/IDs/cells and same preregistered rule. Zero model forwards; not independent model replay.
stop_rule: After exact 8 forwards and independent stored-logit arithmetic, stop. If fixed rule fails, reject this bounded BN-gap rule without expanded budget. Any source/hash/shape/ID/finite/runtime/storage/check failure preserves prefix and exits, no automatic retry or widened tolerance.
privacy: Raw external IDs and 8 logits remain private_outputs on DISLAB and are not staged to public Git.
